name: Corporate Action Movement Cash Movement Details SD 5
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action movement details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the value is a debit or a credit.

PayoutType.name: Payout Type
PayoutType.definition: Specifies the type of payout associated with the event (for example: principal, long term capital gain).

TransactionAmount.name: Transaction Amount
TransactionAmount.definition: Resulting cash amount concerned in this transaction.

ContraParticipantNumber.name: Contra Participant Number
ContraParticipantNumber.definition: Transaction contra participant identification when shares are distributed / delivered to / from another participant.

EarliestPaymentDate.name: Earliest Payment Date
EarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date/Time on which the posting / draft of cash is scheduled to take place for a transaction.

RDPReferenceNumber.name: RDP Reference Number
RDPReferenceNumber.definition: Unique DTCC legacy reference used for matching and reconciling legacy CCF records. The element will be populated to all levels of the message (event details, options, movements) where applicable to indicate how values are sourced from CCF legacy files. For example: event has 2 related activity types 74, and 54. If event details and cash option are sourced from the activity type 74, then activity type 74 will be in RDP reference number in event details, and also on the cash option. The activity type 54 will be "on" the security option. Also, usage rules will specify the different layouts of the RDP reference number based on DTCC event group (reorganization, distribution, or redemption).

TaxAdjustmentRate.name: Tax Adjustment Rate
TaxAdjustmentRate.definition: Set of the DTC legacy sub reason codes representing tax rate. Used with reason codes ‘TJXD’ ‘TJXF’ ‘TJXI’ ‘TJXL’ ‘TJXR’ ‘TJXT’ ‘TJXU’ to identify the correct tax rate.

TransactionQuantity.name: Transaction Quantity
TransactionQuantity.definition: Quantity used on adjustment transactions which when summed across all extension movements equals the relevant balance in the core message. For example, a summation of loan and borrow movements when summed which is negative will show the net total in the borrow balance in the core message. While a summation of loan and borrow movements which is positive will show in the loan balance.
